title: Renewal, Notice and Rollover Terms by Plan (Commercial Natural Gas Supply)
content:
For Commercial Natural Gas Supply, each plan fixes its renewal loyalty credit, the timing points of the two expiration notices, the grace period after rollover, the plan an expiring agreement converts to, the rollover adder and the late-notice price hold.

## Renewal loyalty credit

| Plan | Renewal loyalty credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | 75.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | 100.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | 75.00 |

## Notice timing and rollover terms

| Plan | Initial renewal notice: earliest (days before contract end) | Initial renewal notice: latest (days before contract end) | Final options notice: latest (days before contract end) | Post-expiry renewal grace (calendar days) | Rollover plan | Rollover adder (USD per therm) | Late-notice price hold (billing cycles) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 0.0850 | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 0.0850 | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 0.0850 | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 0.0850 | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 0.0850 | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 0.0850 | 2 |

## Notes

- The renewal loyalty credit is the only term on this page that differs by plan: $0.00 on the Monthly Index plan, $50.00 on the Fixed Basis 12 and Fixed 12 plans, $75.00 on the Fixed 24 and Carbon Neutral 24 plans and $100.00 on the Fixed 36 plan.
- The initial renewal notice window runs from 90 calendar days before the contract end date at the earliest to 60 calendar days before it at the latest. The final options notice is due no later than 30 calendar days before the contract end date.
- Every plan rolls to the Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index plan, with a rollover adder of $0.0850 per therm over the monthly index.
- The post-expiry renewal grace period is 15 calendar days and the late-notice price hold is 2 billing cycles on every plan.
